sources.entry: Claude Code Workflows by Patrick Ellis - Three review workflows developed at an AI-native startup: automated PR code review (dual-loop, GitHub Actions plus slash command), security review against OWASP Top 10 with severity-classified findings, and the widely-copied design-review agent that drives Playwright MCP to check UI/UX and accessibility against a live preview. Each ships as a slash command,

summary.one_liner: A collection of three Claude Code workflows (automated PR code review, OWASP-based security review, and a Playwright MCP design/accessibility review) from Patrick Ellis, each packaged as slash commands.
summary.what_it_does: The repository is a companion to Patrick Ellis' YouTube tutorials and offers three review workflows for Claude Code. The code review workflow uses a dual-loop architecture with slash commands and GitHub Actions to check PRs for syntax, completeness, style guide adherence, and bugs. The security review workflow looks for vulnerabilities, exposed secrets, and attack vectors based on the OWASP Top 10, producing severity-classified findings with remediation guidance, with slash commands for on-demand scans and GitHub Actions for automated PR checks. The design review workflow uses Microsoft's open source Playwright MCP and specialized Claude Code agents to check front-end changes for UI/UX consistency and accessibility. The README also links to a free companion PDF guide on an orchestration layer covering context, tools, workflows, and verification.
use_cases: Automate pull request code review with AI
Scan a codebase for security vulnerabilities and exposed secrets
Review front-end UI and accessibility in a browser
Run on-demand security scans via slash commands
Set up GitHub Actions for automated PR checks
notable: Dual-loop architecture for automated PR review
Security review mapped to OWASP Top 10 with severity-classified findings
Design review agent that drives Playwright MCP against a live preview
Each workflow ships as a slash command
Companion tutorials on the author's YouTube channel
caveats: README gives no installation or setup steps; workflows are described at a high level and rely on the tutorials for detail
Design review requires a live preview environment and Playwright MCP, as implied by the description
keywords: automate code reviews for my team
